home.title: Definitive Guide
home.intro: Welcome to the ultimate arena where Marvel's heroes and DC's legends collide. Whether you root for Gotham's protector or a web-slinging genius, this is where it all comes together.
home.description1: Discover the stories, rivalries, and epic tales that shaped two of the greatest universes in pop culture. Heroes, villains, and everything in between await you here.
home.description2: New to the multiverse? No problem. A seasoned fan? Get ready for some surprises. This guide is your portal to everything Marvel and DC—one click, and you're in.
home.tip: Pro tip: Use the search bar above to find your favorite character or explore the menus to see what each universe has to offer. Time to gear up, hero!
